title: OpenDEA Assessment Criterion
description: A condition that must be demonstrated to establish a particular assessment/maturity state (CR-AM-05A §11). The Criterion is the semantic bridge between evidence and maturity: Question → Response → Observation → Measure → Criterion → MaturityLevel (§13). Multiple Questions may contribute evidence to the same Criterion (§18).

applicability.description: When this criterion applies (e.g. 'all operational domains', 'only where automated decisioning is in scope').

threshold.description: The condition under which the criterion is considered demonstrated. Declarative; interpretation belongs to the scoring/maturity model.

evidence_requirement.description: Evidence required to demonstrate this criterion (§22).

maturity_model.description: The maturity model whose levels this criterion informs (§13). The criterion does not own a level; it bridges evidence to the maturity determination.
